info.description: Public catalog, media, game record, community and account API of haneoka.org. Human-readable documentation: https://docs.haneoka.org/reference/

get.description:
Returns every active resource server, ordered by region and display name. Use `id` as the `{server}` path segment or `server` query value everywhere else in the API.

Authentication: None. Public, anonymous read.

Cache-Control: `public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800`

A tiny document naming the release that is current (or the one you pinned). Call it with `HEAD` to read only the `X-Haneoka-Release-Id` and `X-Haneoka-Source-Id` headers. This is the cheapest way to detect that a new release was promoted.

Authentication: None. Public, anonymous read.

Cache-Control: `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`

**Read the release manifest** (`/api/v1/servers/{server}/release`): The complete file list of the release: every published path with its byte size, media type, role and SHA-256. It is large (tens of MB for `intl`), supports `Range` and `If-None-Match`, and is meant for mirroring tools — application code should read the catalog instead.

get.description:
Without `id`, `limit` or `cursor` this returns the whole index, usually an object keyed by entity ID whose values are the entities themselves. Indexes can be large (the `songs` index is about 580 kB); prefer pagination or batches if you only need part of it. The `events` index additionally carries artwork paths.

Authentication: None. Public, anonymous read.

Cache-Control: `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`

**Page through a collection** (`/api/v1/{resource}?limit={n}&cursor={cursor}`): Sending `limit` or `cursor` returns a page `{ items, total, limit, nextCursor, release }` instead of the index. Items are `{ id, value }` pairs in a stable storage order (not sorted by ID). A page may contain fewer than `limit` items — even zero — while `nextCursor` is non-null; keep requesting until `nextCursor` is `null`. The cursor pins the release of the first page, so a promotion mid-iteration cannot mix data. Only `collection` resources and views can be paged.

**Read a batch of entities** (`/api/v1/{resource}?id={id}&id={id}`): Repeat `id` up to 100 times. Duplicate IDs are removed and the list is sorted before lookup, so `?id=b&id=a` and `?id=a&id=b` share a cache entry. Unknown IDs are reported in `missing` instead of failing the request.

`tree` is `assets` (Unity asset exports; `path` starts with `Assets/` or `Packages/`), `runtime` (decoded audio, video, Live2D and sprite outputs) or `objects` (raw Unity objects; `path` starts with `unity/`). Paths with a language suffix such as `(en)` fall back automatically: `(zh-Hans)` ↔ `(zh-Hant)`, then the unsuffixed file. Media types are taken from the release index; types that are unsafe to render inline are sent as `application/octet-stream` with `Content-Disposition: attachment`.

get.description:
Returns `haneoka-team-builder-data-v1` for the current release, or for `?release=` when pinned. The body is several megabytes of JSON (about 2.8 MB for `intl`, compressed on the wire). Read the release headers to know which release you received, and pin that ID on later requests so the data never changes under a saved team.

Authentication: None. Public, anonymous read.

Cache-Control: `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Resource server slug from `GET /api/v1/releases`, for example `intl` or `jp`.

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Pin an immutable release, `r-` followed by 20 lowercase hex digits. Omit it to read the current release. See [Servers and releases](https://docs.haneoka.org/concepts/servers-and-releases/).

members.description: Member cards keyed by ID: character, band, rarity, attribute, localised `name`, max stats, skill IDs, growth groups.

snapshots.description: Support cards (snaps) keyed by ID, with support and gekiso support skill slots.

characters, bands, bandItems.description: Lookup tables used for bonuses and display.

songs.description: Songs with types, tags, jackets and per-difficulty data including difficulty estimates.

events, eventRules.description: Events in the release and their bonus rules.

skills, skillReference.description: Leader, live, gekiso and support skills plus the condition/effect reference tables.

liveTools, gekisoRules, runtimeRules.description: Scoring tables, judgement timing and native rule tables used by the engine.

gaps.description: Known modelling gaps for this release; an empty list means none are known.

400.description:
`invalid_server`: The server segment is not a valid slug.
`invalid_release`: `release` is not an `r-` followed by 20 hex digits, or was sent on a route that rejects it.

404.description:
`server_not_found`: The server slug is not an active resource server.
`release_not_found`: The requested release is not available on this server.

502.description:
`release_identity_invalid`: The stored release identity is malformed.
`release_identity_mismatch`: Catalog reads returned a different release while building the DTO.
`team_data_unavailable`: The team builder data could not be assembled from the catalog.

503.description: `release_unavailable`: No current release is published for the server yet.

Authentication: Required: a session cookie, the `X-Haneoka-Expected-User` header and a same-origin request.

Cache-Control: `private, no-store`

get.summary: Read the token and its owner
get.description:
Returns the token's name, expiry and scopes. `profile` is filled when the token has `profile:read`.

Authentication: Required: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Cache-Control: `private, no-store`

401.description: `invalid_token`: The token is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

403.description:
`account_restricted`: The owner cannot sign in or was deleted.
`insufficient_scope`: The token lacks the scope.

429.description: `rate_limit_exceeded`: Try again later.
